plan.title: SHG Loan Register Overview
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for SHG loans

panels.title: Total Loans Disbursed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Overdue Loans
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register WHERE "Repayment Status"='Overdue'

panels.title: Loan Purpose Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose" AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Repayment Status Breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
